Interface Account

public interface Account
An account owned by one bank client, initially with a zero balance. A debit account cannot become negative. A credit account may reach the negative credit limit, including that exact boundary. Use BigDecimal arithmetic without rounding or converting to double. Monetary values are compared numerically; scale is irrelevant. Implement this interface in your own class or classes.

JaroslavGr

  • Method Details

    • getNumber

      String getNumber()
      Returns the stable account number. It must be nonblank and never reused by its bank, even after an account is closed. No particular format or uniqueness across different banks is required.
      Returns:
      the account number

    • getHolderName

      String getHolderName()
      Returns the holder name exactly as supplied when the account was opened.
      Returns:
      the nonblank holder name

    • getBalance

      BigDecimal getBalance()
      Returns the current balance; a negative value represents borrowed funds.
      Returns:
      the non-null balance

    • deposit

      boolean deposit(BigDecimal amount)
      Adds a strictly positive amount to the balance. Null, zero and negative amounts return false and leave the balance unchanged.
      Parameters:
      amount - the amount to deposit
      Returns:
      true on success, false for an invalid amount

    • withdraw

      boolean withdraw(BigDecimal amount)
      Subtracts a strictly positive amount if the resulting balance is at least zero for a debit account, or at least the negative credit limit for a credit account. Null, zero, negative and unaffordable amounts return false. Every failed withdrawal leaves the balance unchanged.
      Parameters:
      amount - the amount to withdraw
      Returns:
      true on success, false otherwise
